summary: Invalidate the shared browser startup identity after reconnect

replay.detail: Unknown attempts remain non-retryable; no automatic replay is added.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes.

compatibility.detail: Initial discovery reuse is limited to the current startup observation. Reconnect, failed probes and newer identity observations require a fresh capabilities read, including when the first composer mounts late.

recovery.detail: Late composer startup recovers the current authenticated scope instead of switching back to a previous identity. Persisted scope tuples are never rewritten.
